entitymodel.title: eFinance Component Entity Model
entitymodel.description: Customer-facing portal entities for the eFinance plugin. Covers member accounts, corporate accounts, tokens, OTP, consent and audit log.

field.name: codeHash
field.description: SHA-256 hash of the plain OTP

field.name: tokenHash
field.description: SHA-256 of the raw access token

field.name: tokenHash
field.description: SHA-256 of the raw refresh token

field.name: replacedByTokenId
field.description: FK to EfRefreshToken for rotation chain

field.name: dealerPartyId
field.description: dealer proxy application owner, if any

field.name: partnerId
field.description: W9 partner handoff attribution, if any

field.name: draftJson
field.description: JSON blob of all step data

field.name: submittedApplicationId
field.description: finance loanApplicationId or leaseApplicationId after submission

field.name: productId
field.description: FinancialProduct id, or * for the application-type default

field.name: fieldType
field.description: text / number / date / checkbox / select / hidden

field.name: documentTypeEnumId
field.description: EFDOC_TYPE: ID_FRONT, ID_BACK, INCOME_PROOF, CORPORATE_REGISTRY, etc.

entity.title: eFinance draft to finance application link

field.name: dealerPartyId
field.description: dealer that submitted on behalf, if any

field.name: partnerId
field.description: W9 partner handoff attribution, if any

field.name: kycSubjectPartyId
field.description: individual being verified (may differ for corporate representative)

field.name: statusId
field.description: EFKYC_STATUS: EFKYC_PENDING, EFKYC_SUBMITTED, EFKYC_VERIFIED, EFKYC_RESUBMIT, EFKYC_REJECTED

field.name: confirmerPartyId
field.description: staff who confirmed; null for automatic

field.name: agreementId
field.description: loanAgreementId or leaseAgreementId after successful signing

field.name: supportCaseId
field.description: support case created on human escalation

field.name: financeContractId
field.description: common finance contract id when known

field.name: subjectKey
field.description: partyId, email or other request subject

field.name: resultEntityId
field.description: created draftId or finance application id
